claim_text: Recycled and reused water wherever possible, including reusing dewatering water in the plant and recovering water from the TSFs to reduce freshwater demand.
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: The report does not disclose FY25 vs FY24 quantitative water data or measurable reductions in freshwater demand.
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that the company recycled and reused water “wherever possible,” specifically by reusing dewatering water in the plant and recovering water from TSFs, with the stated effect of reducing freshwater demand. No evidence fields were provided to substantiate any of these actions (e.g., descriptions of systems in place, operational results, volumes of water reused/recovered, time period, or demonstrated reduction in freshwater withdrawals). Because there is no substantive evidence verifying that these practices occurred or reduced freshwater demand, the claim is not meaningfully supported.
